entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hi, I need to return an item. Order number is VF7781-B.
Okay, one moment while I pull that up. VF7781-B... I see it here. This is for the Mountain Bike cycling shoes, correct?
That's them. I want to start a return.
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, what specifically is the issue with the shoes? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
They don't work for me. They're giving me blisters every time I ride. I just need a refund.
I'm sorry to hear about the blisters. Sometimes an issue like that can be resolved by adjusting the cleats or trying a different insole to get a better fit...
Look, I don't have time to experiment. I've tried. Can I return them for a refund, yes or no?
Yes, of course. Let me just confirm the delivery date. I see here the order was delivered 44 days ago. According to our return policy, you are well within the 90-day window for a full refund.
Okay, good. What's the next step?

I have just authorized the return in our system. I'm sending you an email with a prepaid shipping label right now. Simply box up the cycling shoes, attach the label, and you can drop it off at any post office. Your refund will be processed as soon as we receive the item.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
